extra_vocab.en: in a way that needs quick action right away
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇備忘錄裡，urgently 修飾 contact，提醒需要搬運重型設備的員工要盡快聯絡總務處；後面的 preferably before Friday 再把「盡快」具體化成期限。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: urgently 是副詞，修飾動詞，通常放在動詞片語後面（contact the office urgently）；要修飾名詞時用形容詞 urgent（an urgent request）。

example.en: We urgently need a larger storage room for the new equipment.
example.zh: 我們迫切需要更大的儲藏室來放新設備。

example.en: The board must act urgently to prevent further losses.
example.zh: 董事會必須緊急採取行動，以防止更多損失。

example.en: Several customers urgently request a faster refund process this month.
example.zh: 本月有數位顧客緊急要求更快的退款流程。

examples.en: Please reply urgently if you cannot attend the safety briefing.
examples.zh: 如果你無法參加安全說明會，請盡快回覆。

examples.en: The manager asked us to fix the server problem urgently.
examples.zh: 經理要求我們緊急修復伺服器的問題。

examples.en: Employees should report any damage urgently to the facilities office.
examples.zh: 員工應立即向總務處回報任何損壞。

confusable.diff: important 強調「重要」，不一定要馬上處理；urgent／urgently 強調「時間緊迫」。

example.en: This report is important, but it can wait until next week.
example.zh: 這份報告很重要，但可以等到下週再處理。

similar.diff: immediately 是「立刻、馬上」，語氣更強、沒有緩衝時間；urgently 強調事情緊急、需要快速處理。

example.en: Please call the client immediately after the meeting ends.
example.zh: 會議一結束，請立刻打電話給客戶。

similar.diff: as soon as possible 是「越快越好」，語氣較客氣、較常用在請求；urgently 更強調情況緊急。

example.en: Please send the signed contract as soon as possible, preferably today.
example.zh: 請盡快寄回簽好的合約，最好今天。

example.en: Safety is our top priority during the repair work.
example.zh: 維修期間，安全是我們的首要考量。

example.en: The deadline for the budget report is next Friday.
example.zh: 預算報告的截止日是下週五。

example.en: We had to rush the order to meet the shipping date.
example.zh: 我們得趕這張訂單，才能趕上出貨日。

derived.link: urge 是詞幹，「用力催」；加上 -ent 就變成形容詞 urgent「緊急的」
urgent 把 t 換成 -cy，變成名詞，像 agent → agency

example.en: The client urgently needs a revised quote before noon.
example.zh: 客戶在中午前迫切需要一份修正後的報價。

example.en: We received an urgent request from the head office this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上我們收到總公司的緊急要求。
